note: Tier-2 threat deck, 146 (Matt's threat card standard, 2026-11-07): bigger consequences, about two tier-1s; four cards re-cut from the old tier 3 (Last Ultimatum, Iron Curtain, War Economy, Cascade Failure). Counters: 4 energy, 4 ambassadors, 4 insight (r89; 7 before), 5 research cubes, 4 chips, 3 tags or 11 credits. Value lines are 146's pricing, not recomputed: they price the retired 17-credit counter and that day's configs/agents/values.json, so their numbers and ratios are stale. Source: experiments/results/146_threat_standard/threat_cards.py.
